metadata.title: Premium Body Care and Home Fragrance Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based product streams for premium body care, home fragrance, gifting, replenishment, refill adoption, assisted retail, and product launch governance.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each experience carries only experience-specific flows. Each flow step lists the bricks and external systems used inside that experience.

rootGroups.name: Customer Growth
rootGroups.description: Customer-facing experiences that increase confidence, gifting conversion, and retained routine value.

streams.name: Discover a Scent-Led Routine
streams.description: Help shoppers translate a mood, scent family, skin need, room moment, or occasion into a confident routine choice.

flows.title: Discover a Scent-Led Routine
flows.description: From broad intent to confident product shortlist.

dependencies.name: Brand Home and Campaign Entry
dependencies.description: Seasonal, campaign, and routine entry surfaces.
dependencies.how: Makes relevant routines and gift moments easy to enter.

dependencies.name: Scent and Routine Recommendations
dependencies.description: Recommendation logic for scent, routine, and occasion fit.
dependencies.how: Turns preference and intent signals into a narrowed choice set.

dependencies.name: Product Catalog and Claims
dependencies.description: Structured product, scent, size, ingredient, and claim data.
dependencies.how: Provides the facts required to compare products.

dependencies.name: Ritual Content and Education
dependencies.description: Usage guidance, routine education, and brand storytelling.
dependencies.how: Explains how the product fits a routine or recipient.

dependencies.name: Reviews and Social Proof
dependencies.description: Ratings and moderated customer feedback.
dependencies.how: Reduces uncertainty for sensory products.

dependencies.name: Gift Builder and Occasion Logic

dependencies.how: Turns gifting intent into a concrete configuration.

dependencies.name: Bundles and Set Assembly
dependencies.description: Bundle and gift set component rules.
dependencies.how: Ensures the set is sellable, available, and margin-safe.

streams.name: Replenish and Refill a Routine
streams.description: Help members keep favorite products in stock, choose the right refill, and reorder with low friction.

flows.title: Replenish and Refill a Routine
flows.description: From predicted depletion to successful reorder or refill switch.

dependencies.name: Replenishment and Reorder
dependencies.description: Reorder timing and reminder orchestration.
dependencies.how: Triggers the right replenishment moment.

dependencies.name: Refill and Circular Packaging
dependencies.description: Refill eligibility and compatibility logic.
dependencies.how: Shows the correct refill path and avoids wrong-fit purchases.

dependencies.name: Loyalty Membership and Rewards
dependencies.description: Member benefits, rewards, and status.
dependencies.how: Applies benefits and reinforces member value.

streams.name: Personalize Member Value and Offers
streams.description: Use consented customer, loyalty, pricing, promotion, and experimentation signals to make routine recommendations and benefits relevant without eroding premium margin.

flows.title: Personalize Member Value and Offers
flows.description: From consented member signal to measured routine expansion or offer outcome.

dependencies.name: Personalization and Next Best Action
dependencies.description: Next-best-action decisions for products, routines, refills, content, and offers.
dependencies.how: Ranks the next useful action for the member across channels.

dependencies.name: Promotions and Offer Eligibility
dependencies.description: Promotion, reward, and benefit eligibility decisions.
dependencies.how: Applies offers only when the member, basket, market, and channel are eligible.

dependencies.name: Pricing and Margin Rules
dependencies.description: Market, channel, currency, and margin guardrails.
dependencies.how: Prevents personalized value from undermining premium margin discipline.

dependencies.name: Customer and Product Intelligence
dependencies.description: Analytics and intelligence layer for member and product performance.
dependencies.how: Reports impact on retention, routine breadth, refill adoption, and margin.

dependencies.name: Commerce Risk and Abuse

dependencies.how: Protects margin and customer trust.

outcomes: Lower gift and delivery contact rate

rootGroups.name: Platform Foundations
rootGroups.description: Shared trust, identity, consent, intelligence, and measurement streams used across customer, store, commerce, and product-governance experiences.

streams.name: Operate Trusted Customer and Product Platform
streams.description: Provide identity, consent, data intelligence, experimentation, risk, and profile foundations so customer, store, and launch experiences can personalize and measure safely.

flows.title: Operate Trusted Customer and Product Platform
flows.description: From authenticated, consented interaction to measurable and governed product decision.

dependencies.name: Identity and Account Access
dependencies.description: Customer, advisor, and operator authentication and account access.
dependencies.how: Establishes who is acting and which account or employee context is in scope.

dependencies.name: Consent and Preference Management
dependencies.description: Consent, contactability, and privacy preference enforcement.
dependencies.how: Constrains which data, messaging, personalization, and clienteling actions are allowed.

dependencies.name: Customer Profile and Preferences
dependencies.description: Customer account, preferences, routine, and member context.
dependencies.how: Provides a reusable profile for discovery, replenishment, service, and advisor workflows.

dependencies.name: Experimentation and Experience Measurement
dependencies.description: Experiment assignment, feature flags, exposure, and KPI measurement.
dependencies.how: Lets teams evaluate changes against customer, business, and guardrail metrics.
